name: Some Days in Hell
source: Some Days In Hell is a visual novel inspired by the world of Hazbin Hotel. In this game you play as a damned soul who has fallen into hell. In your adventure, meet and talk to the characters from Hazbin Hotel and try to escape from this strange place !
